sections.text: Antarctic winter sea ice peaked at 17.59m square kilometres on 14 September, reaching its third-lowest maximum level since satellite monitoring began in 1979. sections.text: Douglas Stewart Carter was released from a Utah county jail after spending more than four decades on death row. sections.text: Baroness Brown, chairwoman of the Climate Change Committee, warned that the UK is unprepared for climate change and lives will be lost without more action.
